zones.name: 노을 크레파스 굴
zones.prompt:
Generate ONE exceptionally polished 16:9 landscape illustration for a saved-game location thumbnail in the game STILLDRAWN. No typography, no logo, no borders, no UI, no characters, no monster, no watermarks. Reference 1 is the approved title painting: match its layered torn-paper rock material, substantial textured painterly forms, matte shadows, book-world elegance, and high detail at the same stylization (not photography). Reference 2 is the actual area's background texture and canonical color palette. Transform that material into a memorable spatial scene, not a repetition of the texture. An enclosed subterranean world INSIDE an unfinished sketchbook; a continuous cavern roof and strong foreground/midground/background depth. Not open sky or an outdoor sunset. Compose a clear, iconic central landmark readable even at small thumbnail size, soft dark edges, quiet environmental light, large irregular material shapes, no thin scratch-noise, no uniform repeating motifs. Ground is dark beneath its irregular edge. Distinct zone identity through structure, silhouette and color; warm cream only in small light accents. Essential landmark within center 70% so crop is safe. Premium 2D atmospheric metroidvania background art, no photographic lens effects.
AREA E: sunset crayon cavern, entry and broad hub of region 2. Dominant deep burnt sienna, muted terracotta, rusty amber crayon pigment layers. Wide inviting but mysterious vaulted cave formed from thick overlapping wax-and-paper shelves; two massive soft eroded crayon pillars framing a worn passage, suspended irregular ledges, a modest distant gate marked by three faded pigment patches (red yellow blue), barely glowing amber light filtering through a ceiling fissure. Small pools of dark cooled wax deep below foreground shelf, softly hanging melted-wax lips. Winding traversable layers suggest two routes without looking like a literal map. Soft wax ridges, no geological crystal spikes. This area is enclosed and warm, not lava, not candy, not a literal pile of giant school stationery.
